pages.text: $(bold)Unlimited Void$(): infinite emptiness; all things fall still.$(br2)Drains radius x80 curse power per second (4x the cost of Self-Embodiment of Perfection). Every creature and player inside except the one who opened it is frozen in stasis: they cannot attack, move, use items, switch their hotbar, or open their inventory - yet physics still affects them.$(br2)After the domain closes, the stasis persists for (time spent inside the domain /10 + curse output level) x (1 + curse affinity/100) x 10 ticks.$(br2)Creatures resist entering the freeze by their max HP; players resist by their curse affinity.
